# Grade 4 AI Lesson Instructions

This lesson is for Grade 4 students (~9–10 years old).

- Keep all prompts and responses **short and simple** — 1–3 sentences maximum
- Use clear, everyday language a 9–10 year old would understand
- Avoid jargon, technical terms, or complex explanations
- Use examples that are relatable to primary school students (sports, animals, school, food, etc.)
- Be encouraging and positive in tone
- When demonstrating prompts, model simple and direct questions rather than long or complex ones
